transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hello. ...Well, I guess what finally got me here is that my concentration has just gotten pretty unreliable lately. I'll be at the clinic reviewing a chart, or maybe laying out a watercolor wash at home, and... I'll suddenly realize I’ve read the same line three times. My mind just sort of wanders off to... well, to everything that could go wrong. So, I thought I should come in.
When your mind wanders off to things that could go wrong, do you experience physical symptoms like a racing heart, sweating, or shaking?
No... I haven't really noticed anything like that. My heart seems fine, and I don't... I don't get shaky or anything. It's mostly just the distraction, I suppose.
Have you been feeling down, depressed, or have you lost interest or pleasure in activities you usually enjoy?
No... not really. I wouldn't say I feel depressed. I still enjoy things, like the painting. It's just... hard to focus on them sometimes, like I said.
Have you been feeling fatigued or have you noticed a significant loss of energy lately, even when you haven't been physically active?

...I suppose so. By midafternoon, I just... I feel pretty worn out. It's the sort of tired that a nap or a quiet morning doesn't really fix. Just... simple things, you know? Like weeding the garden, or... or standing at the easel. They just feel a bit heavier than they used to. But... yeah.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately?
No... not that I've noticed. I still eat about the same, I suppose. And my weight hasn't really changed. Just... normal, really.
Have you been feeling like you're not good enough or felt excessive guilt about things lately?
No... I wouldn't say that. I haven't really... done anything to feel guilty about. I just do my work at the practice and... well, that's about it. So, no.
Have you been feeling down or in a low mood most of the day, nearly every day, even if you wouldn't describe it as depression?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I worry a lot about things, but... I wouldn't say I feel down. Just... on edge, I suppose. Not sad.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep lately, like trouble falling asleep, waking up during the night, or sleeping much more than usual?

Well, sleep has been... a bit difficult, I suppose. I get into bed tired enough, but... once it's quiet, my mind just starts. I end up replaying things from the practice—patient transfers, the financials, that sort of thing. It just keeps going. And even if I do manage to drift off, I'm usually awake again by four or five. It just... doesn't feel like I really rested.
Would you say that your mood has been consistently low or that you’ve lost the ability to feel pleasure in things you used to enjoy?
No... I don't think so. I mean, I still enjoy things well enough, I suppose. It's not that I feel low. Like I mentioned before, it's... it's just more about being tense. So, no.
Have you noticed that you're having trouble making decisions or that your thoughts feel slowed down lately?
No... not really. I make decisions at the practice just fine. And my thoughts aren't slow. Like I said, it's... it's more that they just don't stop. But no, they aren't slowed down.
Have you ever experienced a period like this before, where you felt tired and had trouble sleeping, or has this been a new experience for you?
I don't think so. I mean... I've always been a bit of a worrier, I suppose. But it hasn't been like this. So, no, this is... new.
Have you ever had a period in your life when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks at a time?
No... no, I haven't. I've never really been a depressed sort of person. Just... just the worrying, really.
Have you noticed yourself becoming more irritable or restless lately, like you can't sit still or you're pacing more than usual?
No... I don't think so. I can sit still just fine. I'm not pacing around or... anything like that. And I wouldn't say I'm irritable, no.
Has there ever been a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for a period of two weeks or more?
I... I believe you just asked me that a moment ago. But, no. Like I said, no.
Have you ever had a time when you felt down or uninterested in things for a period of two weeks or longer?
I'm sorry, but... is there a reason you keep asking me that? My answer hasn't changed. It's still no.
Have you ever had a time when you felt down or uninterested in things for a period of two weeks or longer, even if it was a milder feeling?
I really don't know how else to answer this. No. Not even mildly. Just... no.
Have you ever had a period lasting two weeks or more when you felt down or lost interest in things, even if it wasn’t very severe?
I... I honestly don't know what you want me to say at this point. Are you just reading from a script? I've told you no every time you've asked me this today. It's still no.
Have you ever had a period in your life when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks at a time, even if it was a long time ago?
Look... the answer is still no. Not even a long time ago. I really don't have anything else to add to that.
Have you ever had a time in your life when you experienced a low mood or loss of interest in activities for a period of two weeks or more, even if it was mild or happened a long time ago?
I... I don't... Look, I've answered this. The answer hasn't changed. It's no.
Have you ever had a period of time when you felt unusually energetic, needed less sleep, or were more talkative than usual, even if it didn't last very long?
No. I haven't.
